quest.title: Focal Point of Ancient Array (III)
quest.description: Find and activate the Verdant Crest

talks.objective: Go to the position on the southern side of the battlefield

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Out of the way! Move!

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: Hehe... what's the hurry...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: One way or another... you're all going to die. But some of you... just get to go a bit earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: He whined about not dying back then... Three years ago... And now... I'll fulfill his wish...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Bjorn? What did you do to him!?

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: He was too weak... the weaklings... Useless... Crawling insects...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: ...Dying is all they're good for, no?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Don't you dare insult him! He's not weak at all!

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: Oh... In your eyes... he was strong...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: But... but the strong die all the same...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: I thought... you understood that better than anyone...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: The ones stronger than you... They all died, didn't they? They died three years ago... and ten years ago as well...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Shut your mouth!

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: Yes... the only weak one here... is you...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: Otherwise... why is it that every time... every time... you're the only one who survives?

dialogues.speaker: Voice From the Monster
dialogues.text: ...You ran from the battlefield, didn't you? Just a coward clinging to life...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Illuga, don't listen to its nonsense!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Enough! Time to die!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #...{NICKNAME}! Let's finish this quickly!

talks.objective: Go to the position on the southern side of the battlefield and take a look

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...How is Bjorn?

dialogues.speaker: Egle
dialogues.text: ...He's badly injured. The attack came too suddenly, and to protect us, he... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Egle
dialogues.text: ...The battlefield was too dangerous, and he was in no state to be moved. We had no choice but to treat him here on the spot, but with the resources we have to hand, it's just...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: ...Captain...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Bjorn!

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry... I couldn't complete the mission...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: You did great! The position remains secure, and everyone's still safe...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: Really...? I did it, then... That's good...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Stop talking. You need rest.

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: If I don't say it now... I won't get another chance...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Don't say that! That's an order from your captain! You'll be fine... You'll be fine...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: Heh... alright... as you command... I won't mention that again...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: But at least... I'll finally be able to face Veyde with no regrets...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: He would say... that we Lightkeepers are like Winter Iceleas...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: In the face of the Wild Hunt... each of us is fragile... like a Winter Icelea's petals... How easily we shatter...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: But... so long as the leaves remain... so long as the roots stay firmly in the soil...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: When the next season comes... and the one after that... new flowers will bloom anew...

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: We will not fail... Isn't that right... Captain...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Yes. We will not fail! I will see that monster buried at my hands once and for all!

dialogues.speaker: Bjorn
dialogues.text: ...You're the strongest among us... I believe in you... Captain...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Rest assured, Bjorn. I'll keep our promise. Rest now... Things will have turned around by the time you recover...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #...{NICKNAME}, Paimon, we need to go. The mission isn't over yet. We can't stay here any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Illuga...

choices.text: We have to keep moving, for Bjorn's sake.
We will defeat the enemy and claim victory.
